主要内容: The Royal Bank of Canada reported that dollar denominated accounts for the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Canada are frozen by an Ontario court order due to civil litigation. In fiscal 2017, these accounts generated less than $3,000 in gross revenue and less than $3,000 in net income. The report was filed on November 29, 2017, and signed by David I. McKay, President and Chief Executive Officer.
